text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're past the fourth corner and heading into the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (This is it! Now's the time for me to—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My legs feel… heavy… But now is when I need to make my move!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Fan favorite Satono Diamond has failed to win the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… Huff, puff…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Aw… She couldn't quite pull it off. I guess Satono Diamond hasn't improved as much as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it looked like she was struggling there at the end. Maybe long distances are tough for her.
choice_data_list: (That wasn't the best she can do.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something felt off about during the race. Satono Diamond was clearly feeling tired near the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have spent too much energy running to the racecourse earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it she hadn't done that, she wouldn't have made it in time for the race. Our hands were tied, but still…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (It took everything I had just to run all 2,000 meters… I never had a chance for first with that kind of performance…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (If I was just a little stronger…)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you run here.
Sorry for making you run here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?! There's no need for you to apologize!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I thought getting out of the taxi and running was the best decision as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But… of all the days for a storm. And losing like that, without being able to put everything into the race…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The Satono family is jinxed. We can never win a G1 race. That goes for me as well…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will be the one to break this jinx!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Next is the Japanese Derby, where I'll break the jinx and show everyone that our family can win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's declaration rings with determination. This spate of misfortune appears to have strengthened her resolve to break the jinx.
